scope: Validated publication artifact sets must contain unambiguous, edition-bound format identities

evidence.red: rejects re-signed artifact sets with duplicate or mismatched artifact identities
evidence.command: npm.cmd --prefix api test -- src/publicationArtifacts.spec.ts src/deliveryProof.spec.ts src/releasePreflight.spec.ts

boundary: A byte-valid but ambiguous or cross-edition artifact manifest is non-authoritative and cannot reach preflight or delivery proof.
